body:
I think it would be a good idea to add a specific explanation on why you should add the `@tool` annotation to scripts defining a custom `ResourceFormatLoader` or `ResourceFormatSaver`.

Without it, the loader/saver still works fine at runtime, but in the editor things might not work as expected. For example, `preload` statements will raise an error and you won't be able to load your custom resources inside an `EditorScript`.

The annotation is already present in the examples you added, but maybe I would add something like:
"You should give it a global class name with `class_name` for it to be registered, ***while also adding the `@tool` annotation for it to be available in the editor.***"
